subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support a delegated Google Workspace user identity, and if so should it use interactive user OAuth, administrator-approved domain-wide delegation, or remain service-account-only with explicit fallbacks?
rationale: Google Chat user authentication changes user attribution, consent/administrator requirements, token ownership, and the secrets lifecycle; source-level implementation cannot safely choose that product and security contract.

options.title: Adopt a delegated-identity contract
options.body: Define a secret-aware OAuth or domain-wide-delegation profile for the Google Chat plugin and route only user-required operations through it while preserving service-account defaults.

options.title: Keep app authentication only
options.body: Retain the existing service-account scope boundary and improve unsupported-operation warnings or URL-link delivery without promising native uploads, reactions, or alias-based DMs.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Leave this plugin service-account-only until a maintainer sponsors a supported Workspace OAuth onboarding and credential-management flow.

recommendation.title: Adopt a delegated-identity contract
recommendation.body: Define a secret-aware OAuth or domain-wide-delegation profile for the Google Chat plugin and route only user-required operations through it while preserving service-account defaults.
